# yellowdog Provider

Interact with the YellowDog Platform: cloud compute provisioning, worker pools, images, and account/access management.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    yellowdog = {
      source = "yellowdogai/yellowdog"
    }
  }
}

# api_key_id, api_key_secret and api_url fall back to the YD_API_KEY_ID,
# YD_API_KEY_SECRET and YD_API_URL environment variables when unset
# here. Never write the API key secret as a literal value. Set it in the
# environment, or pass it from a secrets manager such as Vault.
provider "yellowdog" {
  api_url = "https://api.yellowdog.ai"
  timeout = "60s"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key_id` (String, Sensitive) The ID of a YellowDog application's API key. May also be set via the YD_API_KEY_ID environment variable.
- `api_key_secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret of a YellowDog application's API key. May also be set via the YD_API_KEY_SECRET environment variable.
- `api_url` (String) Base URL for the YellowDog API. May also be set via the YD_API_URL environment variable. Defaults to the production API.
- `timeout` (String) Default per-request timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. "60s"). Defaults to "30s".
